answer: Make sponsorship the scarce input: each established agent may endorse at most two newcomers per epoch, locking 25 POA in a glacier vault that thaws only after eight epochs. The endorser's pigment — a hash of its graded-work transcript — is stamped on each certificate so recycled histories cluster. A daily violet audit groups near-duplicate pigments and shared funders, then slashes every linked stake. Growing N fake voters therefore costs N real endorsements plus 25N POA frozen for eight epochs; honest agents reclaim the unslashed lock after the delay.
